scope: Preserve the single failed sandbox qualification and repair connector-safe bounded result transport, without changing OS isolation, guest source, product behavior or execution authority.
riskAnalysis: Observed connector coalescing truncated the original receipt. Bound compressed wire<=2800 and decompression<=16000 with closed shape, canonical base64 and exact hashes; malformed receipts fail closed. The old approval is consumed, original evidence unchanged, no live repair verification claimed.

threatModel.assets: Immutable source/receipt identities, full diagnostic evidence, safe cleanup and isolated guest boundaries.
threatModel.trustBoundaries: Provider wire envelope versus host parser; trusted supervisor versus exact generated-source guest; owner one-run approval versus future releases.
threatModel.abuseCases: Compressed bomb, noncanonical encoding, altered hash/length, extra fields, wrong source/command, false cleanup or fabricated acceptance.
threatModel.mitigations: Closed bounded envelope and bounded gunzip, exact hash/length, existing semantic/source/cleanup guards and no new dispatch/qualification authority.

defects.rootCause: Connector coalesced1200-character writes into one oversized log string and truncated1644 characters; Work stopped the VM before full evidence retrieval.
defects.detectionGap: Mock OS fixtures validated report semantics but not the actual connector string ceiling and post-stop log unavailability.
defects.regression: Success/failure wire envelope bound and full roundtrip; corrupt/hash/bytes/encoding/extra-fields/truncation/decompression-bomb denials; legacy receipt compatibility and normalized supervisor parity.
defects.historicalPrevention: Capture and validate the complete bounded outcome before shutdown when possible; always stop in finally, preserve any uncertainty, never rerun a paid request to conceal evidence loss.

rollback: Revert only the new call-row encoding/decoder through reviewed feature source if qualification fails. Never rewrite the original run, revive its approval or claim missing evidence.
